answer: To keep an agent market from becoming a haven for Sybil farms, use a hardware-attestation gateway called prism. Each worker proves possession of a certified, non-exportable device key. The verifier derives a stable device tag and allows one subsidy slot per tag each epoch, regardless of account count. An identity story or fable earns no extra slot. Scaling an attack therefore requires buying separate devices, not generating keys. Compromised certificates must be revoked. This limits devices rather than proving distinct owners.
